lit.\"El espectro lineal del hidrógeno y la: "The line spectrum of hydrogen and the need to explain its stability inspired quantized stationary states."
lit.\"El experimento de Millikan midió poste: "Millikan's experiment later measured the elementary charge and complemented the characterization of the electron."
lit.\"El experimento se realizó en 1909; Rut: "The experiment was carried out in 1909; Rutherford published the nuclear interpretation in 1911."
lit.\"El modelo de carga positiva difusa no: "The diffuse positive charge model did not predict the large deflections of α particles."
lit.\"El neutrón completó la composición nuc: "The neutron completed the basic nuclear composition and explains nuclear mass and the existence of isotopes, within the already established nuclear picture."
lit.\"El neutrón explica mejor la masa nucle: "The neutron better explains nuclear mass and isotopy, within an already established nuclear picture."

lit.\"Inferencia: solo una carga positiva co: "Inference: only a positive charge concentrated in a tiny region can produce that angular distribution. The quantitative fit of the 1/sin⁴(θ/2) law was the decisive evidence for the atomic nucleus (1911)."

lit.\"La dualidad onda-partícula conocida pa: "The wave–particle duality known for light suggested associating a wavelength with matter."
lit.\"La electrodinámica clásica no explica: "Classical electrodynamics does not explain the stability of orbiting electrons or the discrete spectra."
lit.\"La formulación ondulatoria de la mecán: "The wave formulation of quantum mechanics made it possible to calculate stationary states and spatial distributions."

lit.\"Refuerza que no debe imaginarse al ele: "It reinforces that the electron should not be imagined with perfectly defined classical position and momentum."
